News

Welcome

Government of Bihar was a pioneer State in the implementation of electronic tendering for procurements in 2009 for augmenting transparency, confidentiality and security in public procurement domain. Bihar State Electronics Development Corporation (BSEDC), a Government of Bihar undertaking, is the Nodal agency for its implementation. To address the ever changing needs of Government in the procurement domain, a new e-Procurement platform (e-Proc2.0) is being implemented. This will have features to further enhance security and confidentiality; fully automated payments and refunds mechanism that which shall be implemented in phases; online authentication/ validations, etc. The new platform is envisaged to provide a host of features that will bring process efficiencies and facilitate ease of use.
